About the job

Key Responsibilities:

1. Perform day-to-day PLC and MES automation monitoring, troubleshooting, and system checks.
2. Develop and modify basic Ladder Logic programs for Rockwell PLCs as per automation requirements.
3. Work extensively with MS SQL Server (MSSQL) to retrieve, analyze, and execute queries for production and machine run data, and provide the required data for operational and troubleshooting activities.

Java PLC Programming SQL
